query: UPDATE rec_build_state SET generation  = CASE WHEN $1 THEN generation + 1 ELSE generation END, stage       = CASE WHEN $1 THEN 'full:features' ELSE 'incremental' END, started_at  = now(), finished_at = NULL, series_built = 0, stage_total = 0, error       = NULL WHERE id AND stage = 'idle' RETURNING generation
